name: AiOverviewControl
author: Bernardo Gomes
description: Quota, billing, authentication, and local usage telemetry for 40+ AI providers — Claude, Codex, Copilot, Gemini, Antigravity, OpenRouter, xAI, DeepSeek, Kimi, and more — from DankBar. Credentials are read from each provider's own CLI, auth files, or keyring and sent only to that provider's official API
